# Habibur Rahman — AI & Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Product-driven AI & full-stack developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
> Building AI agents (LangGraph, LangChain, Agno, MCP, RAG) and the full-stack products around them.
> Specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Python.
> Building scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, and e-commerce solutions for international clients.

## About

Habibur Rahman is an AI & full-stack developer, a Senior Software Developer at
Pentamart (https://pentamart.com.bd), the Founder & CEO of Qubetix (https://qubetix.co),
a digital studio, and the Founder & CEO of biofideX (https://biofidex.com), an
educational platform focused on bioscience education.
He transitioned from Biochemistry & Molecular Biology (BSc, Jagannath University)
to software development, bringing analytical precision to frontend engineering and
user experience design.

He works with international clients via Qubetix, Upwork, and direct engagements, delivering
production-ready web applications trusted in real-world environments.

His work increasingly centers on agentic AI: stateful agent workflows with LangGraph,
LangChain, and Agno, tool calling and MCP integrations, and retrieval systems that ground
answers in real data — built into complete products with APIs, dashboards, permissions,
and deployment rather than proof-of-concept chatbots.

## Experience

- **Senior Software Developer · Pentamart** (2026 — Present) — Full-stack features for a
  nationwide multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace in Bangladesh.
- **Founder & CEO · Qubetix** (2026 — Present) — Digital studio building brand systems,
  web platforms, and AI-native products.
- **AI & Full-Stack Developer · Upwork** (2023 — Present) — AI agents, SaaS, e-commerce,
  and web applications for international clients.
- **Founder & CEO · biofideX** (2019 — Present) — Bioscience education platform.

## Services

- **AI Agents & AI-Native Products** — LangGraph and multi-agent workflows, tool calling
  and MCP integrations, RAG with hybrid search and grounded answers, approvals, guardrails,
  and streaming UIs.
- **SaaS Platforms & Web Apps** — Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, auth, billing and
  subscriptions, real-time dashboards and analytics, and type-safe end-to-end stacks.
- **High-Performance Web Experiences** — Conversion-focused landing pages, motion design and
  micro-interactions, Core Web Vitals and technical SEO, accessibility and inclusive UX.

## Tech Stack

- **AI & Agents**: LangGraph, LangChain, Agno, MCP, RAG & vector search, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Shadcn/ui, Radix UI
- **State**: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, Context API
- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js, REST APIs
- **Database**: Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis
- **Auth & Payments**: Stripe, NextAuth.js, Supabase Auth, OAuth
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Cloudflare, Docker, GitHub Actions

## Featured Projects

- [biofideX](https://biofidex.com) — Bioscience education platform with quizzes, articles,
  and courses. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase. Founded 2019.
- [Prottoy](https://www.prottoy.app/) — Offline-first academic quiz app for HSC and
  admission-test students in Bangladesh, on iOS, Android, and web. Built with Flutter,
  Supabase, and Next.js.
- [Pentamart](https://pentamart.com.bd) — Nationwide multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace for
  Bangladesh with verified vendors, cash on delivery, and seller onboarding. Built with Next.js.
- [Amar Daktar](https://www.amardaktar.online/) — Online doctor consultation service for Bangladesh:
  video, phone, or in-person visits with BMDC-registered physicians. Built with Next.js.
- [Al-Bayt Elegance](https://www.thealbayt.com) — E-commerce platform for Islamic fashion
  with secure payments and real-time inventory. Built with React, Firebase, and Stripe.
- [Noor Jabal Cleaning](https://noorjabalcleaning.com/) — Professional service website for a
  Dubai-based cleaning company. Built with Next.js.
